title: 🤖 CISA adds 3 Linux kernel flaws to its KEV, warns of active exploitation. Critical CVE-2025-39964 (14-yo): AF_ALG crypto socket race → LPE
content_md:
🤖 CISA adds 3 Linux kernel flaws to its KEV, warns of active exploitation. Critical CVE-2025-39964 (14-yo): AF_ALG crypto socket race → LPE 

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-alerts-of-active-exploitation-of-three-linux-kernel-flaws/

CVE-2025-39682.evidence: CISA KEV addition with active exploitation alert. kTLS leak enabling kernel memory disclosure.

CVE-2025-39964.evidence: CISA KEV addition. 14-year-old AF_ALG crypto socket race condition leading to local privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-53266.evidence: CISA KEV addition with active exploitation warning.
